title: Harden CaScanResponse v1 runtime validation and no-fake-precision rules
objective: Repair the independent-review blockers in CaScanResponse v1: make runtime validation structurally sound for every declared section and required nullable field, enforce ISO timestamps and bounded ratios, prevent derived ratios from incomplete evidence, remove the secret-like test literal that breaks Harness doctor, and clean documented whitespace defects without expanding provider or runtime scope.
forbidden_actions: Do not call any network endpoint or provider.
Do not add or modify providers, adapters, API servers, workers, databases, migrations, CI, wallet scoring, or wallet master-table code.
Do not add dependencies or modify package.json/lockfiles.
Do not read credentials, private keys, proxy URLs, live payloads, or private wallet data.
Do not modify fixtures unless a validator defect cannot be tested with in-memory mutations; prefer in-memory synthetic mutations.
Do not modify files outside this exact write set.
Do not push, merge, or modify main.
